customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be among the best in the market, appreciating its premium appearance, excellent installation process, and transparent pricing. The water quality receives positive feedback, with customers noting it makes a noticeable difference, and they consider it worth the price. The reliability and water taste aspects receive mixed reviews, with some customers reporting the purifier stops working and others saying the water tastes excellent.

reviews.author: Sandeep
reviews.title: Urban Native M1 Pro!
reviews.body: Good Product, Very happy with the Urban Native M1 Pro! The installation was smooth, the design looks great, and the product is easy to use. Excellent experience and value for money.

reviews.author: rustam ali
reviews.title: The water tastes remarkably fresh and pure, operation is completely silent
reviews.body: The Native M1 Pro Water Purifier exceeds all expectations. The water tastes remarkably fresh and pure, operation is completely silent, and the modern design looks fantastic in the kitchen. Truly a premium product that offers complete peace of mind. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sudipta Mondal
reviews.title: Excellent quality and hassle-free experience
reviews.body: I am writing this review after using the purifier for two years, and I am extremely satisfied. Throughout these two years I haven't faced a single issue with the product. The first filter replacement done yesterday. Overall it's a great product with reliable performance, classy look and I would definitely recommend it 👍👍

reviews.author: ParagC
reviews.title: Good Quality and Super Fast Installation
reviews.body: I'm really impressed by the communication and automation offered by Urban Company. As soon as you place order on Amazon, if you have same number registered with UC, they will inform you about Installation Schedule and you can re schedule it if required. The installation was hassle free. Water Quality is good and best part I loved about this Water filter is that it can be used as Table Top and due to mechanical switch you can get water even if Electricity is off. You will get Free Meter to check Water Hardness. Highly recommended.
